name: speech-cpp
description: Umbrella port over the QVAC speech stack with one shared ggml dependency (the qvac-fabric port, the same ggml the LLM stack ships) and selectable whisper, parakeet, TTS, and audiogen engines.

audiogen.description: Build ACE-Step and MiniMax music generation from engines/audiogen, including the explicit MiniMax Core ML runtime on macOS (runtime requires macOS 15+). CMake package: find_package(audiogen-cpp CONFIG) + audiogen-cpp::audiogen-cpp.

coreml.description: Enable the Apple Core ML (Neural Engine) sidecars of every enabled engine that has one: the Parakeet FastConformer encoder, the Nemotron 3 Diarization and Sortformer v2.1 whole-network diarizers, and the MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize audio encoder in parakeet (PARAKEET_COREML); the Audio8 codec synthesis stack, the Supertonic vocoder, the CosyVoice3 LM, flow frontend/decoder, F0 predictor and HiFT vocoder, the MOSS-TTS codec decoder, the MOSS-SoundEffect DiT and VAE, the MOSS-Speech speech tokenizer, and explicit LavaSR denoiser/enhancer models in tts (TTS_CPP_COREML); and the ACE-Step VAE decoder in audiogen (AUDIOGEN_COREML). Runtime model selection and fallback are engine-specific; LavaSR requires both an explicit compiled model path and a compute policy. Combine with the engine features you build; this feature no longer implies parakeet.

cuda.description: Enable CUDA GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Linux / Windows on NVIDIA, via qvac-fabric[cuda-backend]). Needs nvcc on the build host; at runtime CUDA engages only where the NVIDIA driver and the CUDA runtime libraries resolve, and devices without compiled kernels are skipped in favor of Vulkan or CPU.

metal.description: Enable Metal GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (macOS / iOS, via qvac-fabric[gpu-backends], which builds Metal on Apple platforms).

opencl.description: Enable OpenCL GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Android / Adreno, via qvac-fabric[gpu-backends], which builds OpenCL alongside Vulkan on Android).

parakeet.description: Build the Parakeet engine (NVIDIA FastConformer ASR: CTC / TDT / EOU, Nemotron 3.5, Sortformer and Nemotron 3 diarization, plus MOSS-Transcribe-Diarize) from engines/parakeet. CMake package: find_package(qvac-parakeet CONFIG) + qvac::parakeet.

tts.description: Build the TTS engine collection from engines/tts: Chatterbox, Supertonic, CosyVoice3, Parler-TTS, Pocket TTS, Audio8, MOSS Delay, MOSS-SoundEffect, MOSS-Speech and LavaSR speech enhancement, as one library. CMake package: find_package(tts-cpp CONFIG) + tts-cpp::tts-cpp.

vulkan.description: Enable Vulkan GPU acceleration for all enabled engines (Linux / Windows / Android; Apple platforms use the metal feature instead, via qvac-fabric[gpu-backends]).

webgpu.description: Enable the WebGPU (Dawn) GPU acceleration for all enabled engines, via qvac-fabric[webgpu]. Opt-in on every platform, selected at runtime with the engines' backend = "webgpu" option or a --backend webgpu CLI flag. See the qvac-fabric feature for the official-registry ports (dawn and its dependencies) a consumer has to import.

whisper.description: Build the whisper engine from third_party/whisper.cpp (upstream whisper.cpp with the QVAC delta; upstream's bundled parakeet is gated off). CMake package: find_package(whisper CONFIG) + whisper::whisper.
